page_title: BOL 0-2 ATA | Bologna v Atalanta 07/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Federico Ravaglia has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
90+1' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Referee Marco Di Bello has finally had enough of Raffaele Palladino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
87' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
86' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
85' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Marco Di Bello signals a set piece.
84' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Charles De Ketelaere and he is replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
83' The game is interrupted as Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is flagged offside.
82' Juan Miranda (Bologna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolo Cambiaghi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
78' A pass by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
77' Here is a change. Nikola Krstovic is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
77' It's time for a substitution. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) comes on in place of Ederson.
75' Looks like Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
74' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) commits a foul and Marco Di Bello immediately signals a free kick.
72' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Remo Freuler is replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
72' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian leaves the pitch and is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
71' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

70' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.
68' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Nicola Zalewski will be replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
68' The substitution has been made. Isak Hien (Atalanta) has replaced Giorgio Scalvini.
67' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' Remo Freuler (Bologna) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
63' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

60' 0 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
60' A substitution has been made. Thijs Dallinga is replaced by Ciro Immobile (Bologna).

59' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is first to react to a whipped in corner and flashes a header in on goal from close range, but one of his teammates inadvertently blocks the ball and stops him scoring. No wonder he's upset!
59' The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.
59' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
58' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
57' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
56' The linesman signals that Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta).
52' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) tries to find Nadir Zortea, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
51' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
46' Riccardo Orsolini goes off the pitch and Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) comes on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) attempts to beat Federico Ravaglia with a header from the resulting corner kick. He sends his effort towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a nice save. The score remains the same.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
45' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
44' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
42' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
41' Remo Freuler (Bologna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
40' Juan Miranda (Bologna) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
40' Marco Di Bello blows the whistle, Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Bologna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
37' 0 - 1 Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
37' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
36' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Remo Freuler (Bologna) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
35' The corner is swung in and Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in.
35' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) prepares to take a corner kick.
34' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
33' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
31' The resulting corner from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is cleared by the defence.
30' An attempted cross from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is cleared. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
28' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
27' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.
25' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
23' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' The foul by Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
19' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
14' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
14' Atalanta are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
12' Martin Vitik (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
10' Neat link-up play between Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) and Nikola Krstovic, but Federico Ravaglia reads the game well and the move breaks down.
8' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' A pass lands at the feet of Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
6' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and it's Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Good chance! Ederson (Atalanta) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
3' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
2' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is flagged for offside.
1' A thunderous effort from long range by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) goes well wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will supervise the game today.
